exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI CHIZMA — ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  CHIZMA A — EGA so'raladi

     [SUBJECT]      [       ]      [OBJECT]
        Ann     —   married   —     Peter
         ↕
     WHO married Peter?
     (not: Who DID marry Peter?)

     Savol so'zi EGA ('Ann') o'rniga turibdi →
     'DID' KERAK EMAS.
     Fe'l TASDIQ shaklida qoladi: 'married'.


  CHIZMA B — TO'LDIRUVChI so'raladi

     [SUBJECT]      [       ]      [OBJECT]
        Ann     —   married   —     Peter
                                       ↑
     WHO did Ann marry?

     Savol so'zi TO'LDIRUVChI ('Peter') o'rniga turibdi →
     'DID' KERAK.
     Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: 'marry'.


QANDAY ANIQLASh — QALIN SO'Z QAYERDA:

  Qalin so'z gapning BOShIDA (harakatni BAJARUVChI)?
     → EGA → 'did' YO'Q, fe'l O'TGAN shaklda

  Qalin so'z gapning OXIRIDA (harakat TUShADIGAN narsa)?
     → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR, fe'l ASOSIY shaklda


ENG MUHIM XATO:
  'Who DID MARRY Peter?' — kitob buni ATAYLAB
  '(not: ...)' deb ko'rsatgan.
  Ega so'ralganda 'did' ISHLATILMAYDI.


BIR XIL SAVOL SO'ZI, IKKI XIL MA'NO:

  WHO married Peter?   — Piterga KIM turmushga chiqdi?
     javob: ANN married Peter.

  WHO did Ann marry?   — Ann KIMGA turmushga chiqdi?
     javob: Ann married PETER.

  Ikkalasi ham 'Who' bilan boshlanadi, lekin
  BUTUNLAY BOShQA narsani so'raydi.


ESLATMA:
  45-betning oxiridagi qoida qutisi va Grammar 50-betdagi
  10-mashq ham aynan shu haqda.

points.en: A: Ann (SUBJECT) married Peter (OBJECT). → Who married Peter?
points.uz: Ann (EGA) Piterga (TO'LDIRUVCHI) turmushga chiqdi. → Piterga kim turmushga chiqdi?
points.noteUz:
EGA so'ralmoqda → 'DID' KERAK EMAS.
Fe'l TASDIQ shaklida: 'married'.

Kitob bu XATONI ATAYLAB ko'rsatgan.
Ega so'ralganda 'did' ISHLATILMAYDI.

points.en: B: Ann (SUBJECT) married Peter (OBJECT). → Who did Ann marry?
points.noteUz:
TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralmoqda → 'DID' KERAK.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: 'marry'.

points.en: SUBJECT = ega (the doer of the action)
OBJECT = to'ldiruvchi (the receiver of the action)
points.uz: TO'LDIRUVCHI — harakat tushadigan narsa yoki shaxs

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions to which the words in bold type are the answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin yozilgan so'zlar javob bo'ladigan savollar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — har birida BITTA so'z QALIN.

USUL:
  1) Qalin so'z EGAmi yoki TO'LDIRUVChImi — aniqlang
  2) EGA bo'lsa → WHO + O'TGAN fe'l ('did' YO'Q)
     TO'LDIRUVChI bo'lsa → WHO + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l

BU MASHQDAGI TAQSIMOT:

  EGA so'ralgan ('did' YO'Q) — 1, 3, 5, 6-bandlar:
     Marconi, Bill, Da Vinci, Charles Dickens

  TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralgan ('did' BOR) — 2, 4-bandlar:
     Ann, June

DIQQAT: hamma javob 'WHO' bilan boshlanadi —
chunki hamma qalin so'z ODAM yoki ODAM nomi.

items.question: Who invented the radio?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'Marconi' gap BOShIDA → EGA → 'did' YO'Q.
Fe'l 'INVENTED' o'tgan shaklda qoladi.
Markoni — radioni ixtiro qilgan italyan olimi.

items.question: Who did Graham visit?
items.whyUz:
'Ann' gap OXIRIDA → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: 'VISIT' ('visited' EMAS).
DIQQAT: 1-band bilan SOLIShTIRING — u yerda 'did' yo'q edi.

items.question: Who closed the window?
items.whyUz:
'Bill' gap BOShIDA → EGA → 'did' YO'Q.
Fe'l 'CLOSED' o'tgan shaklda qoladi.

items.question: Who did Terry marry?
items.whyUz:
'June' gap OXIRIDA → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: 'MARRY'.
Bu — kitobdagi B-chizmaning aynan o'zi
('Who did Ann marry?').
DIQQAT: 'June' bu yerda AYOL ISMI (oy nomi emas).

items.answer: DA VINCI painted the Mona Lisa.
items.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
items.whyUz:
'Da Vinci' gap BOShIDA → EGA → 'did' YO'Q.
Fe'l 'PAINTED' o'tgan shaklda.
Coursebook 73-betdagi 14-mashqda ham shu gap bor edi.

items.answer: CHARLES DICKENS wrote A Tale of Two Cities.
items.question: Who wrote A Tale of Two Cities?
items.whyUz:
'Charles Dickens' gap BOShIDA → EGA → 'did' YO'Q.
Fe'l 'WROTE' o'tgan shaklda.
Dikkens — Grammar 43-betdagi matnning qahramoni.
'A Tale of Two Cities' = 'Ikki shahar haqida hikoya'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make questions.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Where/you/buy/it/from?
  → Where DID YOU BUY it FROM?

QOLIP:
  [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + qolgan qismi?

DIQQAT — BU MASHQDA HAMMA BANDDA 'DID' BOR:
  Chunki savol so'zi hech qayerda EGA emas —
  hammasi JOY, VAQT, NARSA yoki USUL so'raydi.

DIQQAT — PREDLOG GAP OXIRIDA QOLADI:
  'Where did you buy it FROM?'
  'Who did you go WITH?'
  Predlog savol so'zi bilan birga oldinga ChIQMAYDI.

items.question: Where did you buy it from?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
DID + you + BUY (asosiy shakl).
DIQQAT: 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

items.question: When did John arrive?
items.whyUz:
DID + John + ARRIVE (asosiy shakl).
Ega ISM bo'lsa ham qolip bir xil.
'to arrive' = yetib kelmoq.

items.question: What did you have for lunch?
items.whyUz:
DID + you + HAVE ('had' EMAS).
'for lunch' — 'lunch' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.answer: How / you / get / to school / today?
items.question: How did you get to school today?
items.whyUz:
DID + you + GET.
'How ...?' — USUL so'raladi (transport).
'get TO school' = maktabga yetib bormoq.

items.question: Where did Jane go on holiday?
items.whyUz:
DID + Jane + GO ('went' EMAS).
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.

items.question: What did you do last night?
items.whyUz:
DID + you + DO.
DIQQAT: 'do' fe'li IKKI marta —
'did' (yordamchi) + 'do' (asosiy).
Bu TO'G'RI qolip.

exercises.instructionEn: Then match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI JAVOB:
  a  I went to school by bus.
  b  She went to France.
  c  I went to the cinema.
  d  I bought it from Marks and Spencer.
  e  He arrived yesterday afternoon.
  f  I had a sandwich.

Kitob BIRINI chizib bergan: 1 → d

USUL — SAVOL SO'ZIGA VA EGAGA QARANG:
  Where ... buy ...?  → do'kon nomi → d
  When ... arrive?    → vaqt, ega 'John' → 'He' → e
  What ... for lunch? → ovqat → f
  How ... get ...?    → transport → a
  Where ... Jane ...? → mamlakat, ega 'Jane' → 'She' → b
  What ... last night? → mashg'ulot → c

DIQQAT — OLMOShGA QARANG:
  'John' → javobda 'HE'   (e-javob)
  'Jane' → javobda 'SHE'  (b-javob)
  'you'  → javobda 'I'    (a, c, d, f javoblar)

pairs.left: 1  Where did you buy it from?
pairs.right: d  I bought it from Marks and Spencer.
pairs.rightUz: Uni Marks and Spencer'dan sotib oldim.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
'Where ... from?' → DO'KON nomi.
'Marks and Spencer' — Britaniyadagi mashhur do'kon tarmog'i.
DIQQAT: savolda 'buy', javobda 'bought'.

pairs.rightUz: U kecha tushdan keyin yetib keldi.
pairs.whyUz:
'When ...?' → VAQT javobi.
Ega 'John' (erkak) → javobda 'HE'.
'yesterday afternoon' = kecha tushdan keyin.

pairs.left: 3  What did you have for lunch?
pairs.whyUz:
'What ... for lunch?' → OVQAT javobi.
Savolda 'have', javobda 'had'.

pairs.left: 4  How did you get to school today?
pairs.right: a  I went to school by bus.
pairs.whyUz:
'How ...?' → USUL (transport) javobi.
'BY bus' — transport bilan BY, artikl YO'Q.

pairs.left: 5  Where did Jane go on holiday?
pairs.whyUz:
'Where ...?' → JOY javobi.
Ega 'Jane' (ayol) → javobda 'SHE'.
'go TO France' — mamlakat bilan TO.

pairs.left: 6  What did you do last night?
pairs.right: c  I went to the cinema.
pairs.whyUz:
'What ... do?' → MAShG'ULOT javobi.
'go to THE cinema' — 'the' bilan.
14-mashqdagi dialogda ham shu savol bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the beginning of a story entitled "The Thief", and the key words below. Take it in turns to continue the story using the key words.
exercises.instructionUz: "O'g'ri" nomli hikoyaning boshini va quyidagi kalit so'zlarni o'qing. Navbat bilan kalit so'zlardan foydalanib hikoyani davom ettiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI BOShLANISh:
  S1: It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all
      alone.
  S2: Suddenly, I heard a noise outside.

KALIT SO'ZLAR (16 ta):
  home/alone - hear/noise - look/window - see/dark shadow -
  feel/scared - see/strange/face - close/curtains/quickly -
  sb knock/on/window - scream/loudly - phone/police -
  hide/bed - still hear/scary noises - police/arrive -
  open/door - mother/in the garden - feel/silly

  ('sb' = somebody = kimdir)

O'YIN QOIDASI:
  Navbat bilan (S1, S2, S1, S2 ...) har biringiz
  bitta kalit so'zdan gap tuzasiz va hikoyani
  davom ettirasiz.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA HIKOYA:

  It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all alone.
  Suddenly, I heard a noise outside. I looked out of the
  window and saw a dark shadow in the garden. I felt very
  scared. Then I saw a strange face at the window! I closed
  the curtains quickly. A few seconds later, somebody
  knocked on the window. I screamed loudly and phoned the
  police. Then I hid under the bed. I could still hear
  scary noises outside. After ten minutes, the police
  arrived. I opened the door — and there was my mother in
  the garden! She lost her keys and couldn't get in.
  I felt very silly!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Sovuq, shamolli tun edi va men uyda yolg'iz edim.
  To'satdan tashqarida shovqin eshitdim. Derazadan
  qaradim va bog'da qora soyani ko'rdim. Juda qo'rqib
  ketdim. So'ng derazada g'alati yuzni ko'rdim! Pardalarni
  tez yopdim. Bir necha soniyadan keyin kimdir derazani
  taqillatdi. Baland ovozda qichqirdim va militsiyaga
  qo'ng'iroq qildim. Keyin karavot ostiga yashirindim.
  Tashqaridan hali ham qo'rqinchli shovqinlar eshitilardi.
  O'n daqiqadan keyin militsiya yetib keldi. Eshikni
  ochdim — va bog'da onam turgan ekan! U kalitini
  yo'qotib qo'ygan va uyga kira olmagan ekan.
  O'zimni juda ahmoq his qildim!


HIKOYANING TUZILIShI (Coursebook 81-betdagi qoida):
  1-qism — BOShLANISh: qachon, qayerda, kim
     'It was a cold, windy night ... I was at home, alone.'
  2-3-qism — RIVOJLANISh va ASOSIY VOQEA:
     shovqin → soya → yuz → taqillatish → qichqiriq →
     militsiya → yashirinish
  4-qism — TUGALLANMA: oxirida nima bo'ldi va qanday
     his qildi
     'It was my mother! I felt very silly.'

DIQQAT — KUTILMAGAN OXIR:
  Hikoya o'g'ri haqidadek boshlanadi, lekin oxirida
  ONASI ekani ma'lum bo'ladi — bu KULGILI burilish.
  Shuning uchun oxirgi kalit so'z 'feel/SILLY'
  (o'zini ahmoq his qilmoq).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a shadow   = soya
  a face     = yuz
  curtains   = pardalar
  to knock on = taqillatmoq
  to hide (hid) = yashirinmoq (yashirindi)
  silly      = ahmoq, bema'ni

structure.heading: 1  home/alone + hear/noise
structure.guideUz:
KITOB BERGAN boshlanish.
Qachon, qayerda, kim — hikoya boshlanishining qoidasi.
structure.modelEn: It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all alone. Suddenly, I heard a noise outside.

structure.heading: 2  look/window + see/dark shadow + feel/scared
structure.guideUz:
'look OUT OF the window' — predlog.
'feel + SIFAT' — 'scared'.
structure.modelEn: I looked out of the window and saw a dark shadow in the garden. I felt very scared.

structure.heading: 3  see/strange/face + close/curtains/quickly
structure.guideUz:
'quickly' — RAVISh, fe'ldan keyin.
Undov belgisi qo'rquvni kuchaytiradi.
structure.modelEn: Then I saw a strange face at the window! I closed the curtains quickly.

structure.heading: 4  sb knock/on/window + scream/loudly + phone/police
structure.guideUz:
'sb' = somebody.
'knock ON the window' — predlog ON.
'loudly' — RAVISh.
structure.modelEn: A few seconds later, somebody knocked on the window. I screamed loudly and phoned the police.

structure.heading: 5  hide/bed + still hear/scary noises
structure.guideUz:
hide → HID (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'hide UNDER the bed' — predlog UNDER.
'still' = hali ham.
structure.modelEn: Then I hid under the bed. I could still hear scary noises outside.

structure.heading: 6  police/arrive + open/door + mother/in the garden
structure.guideUz:
Hikoyaning BURILISh nuqtasi —
o'g'ri emas, ONASI ekan.
structure.modelEn: After ten minutes, the police arrived. I opened the door — and there was my mother in the garden!

structure.heading: 7  feel/silly
structure.guideUz:
Coursebook 81-betdagi qoida:
hikoya HIS-TUYG'U bilan tugaydi.
structure.modelEn: She lost her keys and couldn't get in. I felt very silly!

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG.

TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR (to'ldirilgan holda):

1)  A: What time DID YOU GO to bed last night?
    B: At half past one. I STAYED UP late because there WAS
       a great film on TV.
    A: Really? What film?
    B: Horror at Park Town. DID YOU WATCH it?
    A: No, I DON'T LIKE horror films very much.

2)  A: Hi Tom. It'S Gary. How ARE you?
    B: Fine. I CAME home fifteen minutes ago and I'M HAVING
       lunch at the moment.
    A: Lunch? But it'S almost four o'clock!
    B: Well, I DIDN'T TAKE a break for lunch at work today.
       You see, we always HAVE a lot of work in August.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

1)  A: Kecha kechqurun soat nechada yotding?
    B: Bir yarimda. Kech yotdim, chunki televizorda
       ajoyib film bor edi.
    A: Rostdanmi? Qaysi film?
    B: 'Park Taundagi dahshat'. Ko'rdingmi?
    A: Yo'q, men qo'rqinchli filmlarni unchalik yoqtirmayman.

2)  A: Salom Tom. Bu Geri. Yaxshimisan?
    B: Yaxshi. O'n besh daqiqa oldin uyga keldim va hozir
       tushlik qilyapman.
    A: Tushlikmi? Lekin soat deyarli to'rt-ku!
    B: Ha, bugun ishda tushlikka tanaffus qilmadim.
       Bilasanmi, avgustda bizda doim ish ko'p bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 5-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'No, I ...... (not/like) horror films very much.'
  Bu — UMUMIY did (doimiy fikr), o'tgan zamon EMAS →
  PRESENT SIMPLE: 'I DON'T LIKE'.
  Oldingi savol o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa ham, javob
  hozirgi zamonda.

DIQQAT — 11 va 12-BANDLAR JUFTLIKDA:
  'I DIDN'T TAKE a break ... TODAY'  → bugun tanaffus
     qilmadi — TUGAGAN harakat → PAST SIMPLE
  'we ALWAYS HAVE a lot of work'    → doimiy odat →
     PRESENT SIMPLE
  Bir gapda ikki zamon.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay up late  = kech yotmoq
  half past one    = bir yarim
  a horror film    = qo'rqinchli film
  to take a break  = tanaffus qilmoq
  You see          = bilasanmi (tushuntirish kiritadi)

items.textEn: 1  A: What time ............ (you/go) to bed last night?
items.whyUz:
'last night' → PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ.
DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).
'What time ...?' = soat nechada?

items.textEn: 1  B: I ............ (stay up) late because there ............ (be) a great film on TV.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. stay up → stayed up (to'g'ri fe'l).
'to stay up late' = kech yotmoq, uxlamay o'tirmoq.

items.textEn: 1  ... because there ............ (be) a great film on TV.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. 'there WAS a great film'.
'a film' BIRLIK → was.
'ON TV' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 1  B: Horror at Park Town. ............ (you/watch) it?
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ (o'sha kecha haqida).
DID + you + WATCH (asosiy shakl).

items.textEn: 1  A: No, I ............ (not/like) horror films very much.
items.hintUz: DIQQAT — bu umumiy fikr, o'tgan voqea emas!
items.whyUz:
BU BAND ALDAMChI.
Qo'rqinchli filmlarni yoqtirmaslik — DOIMIY fikr,
o'tgan zamondagi bitta voqea EMAS → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'I DON'T LIKE horror films' = umuman yoqtirmayman.
DIQQAT: 'I didn't like' bo'lsa — faqat o'sha filmni
yoqtirmagan bo'lardi, mashqning ma'nosi boshqa.

PRESENT SIMPLE. 'It'S Gary' = Bu Geri.
Telefonda o'zini tanishtirish qolipi.
DIQQAT: 'I am Gary' emas, 'IT IS Gary' —
telefonda shunday aytiladi.

'How ARE you?' — standart salomlashish.
'you' → ARE.

items.textEn: 2  B: Fine. I ............ (come) home fifteen minutes ago ...
items.whyUz:
'... AGO' → PAST SIMPLE.
come → CAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'come home' — predlogsiz.

items.textEn: 2  B: ... and I ............ (have) lunch at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + having.
DIQQAT: 'have lunch' = ovqatlanmoq (HARAKAT) —
shuning uchun -ing OLADI.

items.textEn: 2  A: Lunch? But it ............ (be) almost four o'clock!
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE. 'it'S almost four o'clock'.
Soat aytishda ega DOIM 'it'.
'almost' = deyarli.

items.textEn: 2  B: Well, I ............ (not/take) a break for lunch at work today.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE INKOR: DIDN'T + TAKE (asosiy shakl).
'today' bo'lsa ham, ish kunining tushlik vaqti
allaqachon O'TGAN → past simple.
'take a break' = tanaffus qilmoq.
'didn't took' XATO.

items.textEn: 2  B: You see, we always ............ (have) a lot of work in August.
items.whyUz:
'always' → PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy odat).
'we' KO'PLIK → HAVE (-S YO'Q).
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'have' = ega bo'lmoq → -ing OLMAYDI.
11-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: bir gapda ikki zamon —
'didn't take' (bugun) ↔ 'always have' (doim).

sections.title: Communication — Asking about a Night out

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogue with questions from the list below. In pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi savollar bilan to'ldiring. Juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta savol, 6 ta bo'shliq):
  What did you see, Who was in it, What did you do last
  night, What was it about, Who did you go with,
  Was it a good film

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WHAT DID YOU DO LAST NIGHT?
  B: I went to the cinema.
  A: WHO DID YOU GO WITH?
  B: I went with Elaine.
  A: WHAT DID YOU SEE?
  B: We saw Danger at Midnight.
  A: WHAT WAS IT ABOUT?
  B: It was about a dangerous man.
  A: WAS IT A GOOD FILM?
  B: Yes, it was, but it was very scary.
  A: WHO WAS IN IT?
  B: Jim Hardy and Sara Lloyd.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun nima qilding?
  B: Kinoteatrga bordim.
  A: Kim bilan bording?
  B: Eleyn bilan bordim.
  A: Nima ko'rdinglar?
  B: 'Yarim tundagi xavf' ni ko'rdik.
  A: U nima haqida edi?
  B: Xavfli odam haqida edi.
  A: Yaxshi filmmidi?
  B: Ha, lekin juda qo'rqinchli edi.
  A: Unda kimlar o'ynagan?
  B: Jim Xardi va Sara Lloyd.


USUL — JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOLNI TOPING:
  'I went to the cinema.'     → mashg'ulot → What did you do?
  'I went with Elaine.'       → odam → Who did you go with?
  'We saw Danger at Midnight.' → film nomi → What did you see?
  'It was about a dangerous man.' → mavzu → What was it about?
  'Yes, it was, but ...'      → HA/YO'Q javobi → Was it ...?
  'Jim Hardy and Sara Lloyd.' → aktyorlar → Who was in it?

DIQQAT — 'YES, IT WAS' JAVOBI:
  Bu — HA/YO'Q savolining javobi, shuning uchun savol
  savol so'zi bilan EMAS, 'WAS' bilan boshlanadi:
     'WAS it a good film?'

DIQQAT — PREDLOGLAR GAP OXIRIDA:
  'Who did you go WITH?'
  'What was it ABOUT?'
  'Who was IN IT?'

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a night out = kechki sayr (tashqarida dam olish)
  dangerous   = xavfli
  midnight    = yarim tun
  to be in a film = filmda o'ynamoq
wordList: What did you do last night

lines.answer: What did you do last night
lines.hintUz: Javob: 'I went to the cinema' — mashg'ulot
lines.whyUz:
Javob MAShG'ULOT ('went to the cinema') →
'What did you do last night?'
Dialogning BIRINChI savoli — umumiy savol.
11-mashqning 6-bandida ham shu savol bor edi.

Javob ODAM ('with Elaine') → 'Who did you go WITH?'
DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Bu — TO'LDIRUVChI savoli → 'did' KERAK.

Javob FILM NOMI ('Danger at Midnight') →
'What did you see?'
'did' + SEE (asosiy shakl), javobda 'saw'.

lines.hintUz: Javob: 'It was about a dangerous man' — mavzu
lines.whyUz:
Javob MAVZU ('about a dangerous man') →
'What was it ABOUT?'
DIQQAT: 'be' fe'li → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'about' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

lines.textEn: It was about a dangerous man.

lines.whyUz:
Javob 'YES, it was' → HA/YO'Q savoli →
savol so'zi YO'Q, 'WAS' bilan boshlanadi:
'WAS it a good film?'
Javob: 'Yes, it was, BUT it was very scary' —
'but' qarama-qarshilik.

lines.textEn: Yes, it was, but it was very scary.

lines.whyUz:
Javob AKTYORLAR ismi → 'Who was IN IT?'
= Unda kimlar o'ynagan?
'to be in a film' = filmda o'ynamoq.
DIQQAT: 'be' fe'li → 'did' KERAK EMAS.

groups.ruleUz: EGA va TO'LDIRUVChI savollari — ENG MUHIM FARQ

items.base: Where did you buy it FROM?
We always HAVE a lot of work.
What did you HAVE for lunch?
I DIDN'T TAKE a break today.
we ALWAYS HAVE a lot of work
I CAME home fifteen minutes ago

patterns.formula: WHO + O'TGAN fe'l + to'ldiruvchi?   ('did' YO'Q — EGA so'raladi)
patterns.exampleEn: Who married Peter? Who invented the radio? Who wrote A Tale of Two Cities?
patterns.exampleUz: Piterga kim turmushga chiqdi? Radioni kim ixtiro qildi? 'Ikki shahar haqida hikoya' ni kim yozgan?
patterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi EGA o'rniga tursa, 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Fe'l TASDIQ shaklida qoladi.

patterns.formula: WHO + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   ('did' BOR — TO'LDIRUVChI so'raladi)
patterns.exampleEn: Who did Ann marry? Who did Graham visit? Who did you go with?
patterns.exampleUz: Ann kimga turmushga chiqdi? Grexem kimni ko'rgani bordi? Kim bilan bording?
patterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi TO'LDIRUVChI o'rniga tursa, 'did' KERAK.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

patterns.formula: [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + ... + PREDLOG?
patterns.exampleEn: Where did you buy it from? What was it about?
patterns.exampleUz: Uni qayerdan sotib olding? U nima haqida edi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Predlog gap OXIRIDA qoladi, savol so'zi bilan
birga oldinga chiqmaydi.

patterns.formula: I DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l ... TODAY. We ALWAYS + fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: I didn't take a break for lunch at work today. We always have a lot of work in August.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun ishda tushlikka tanaffus qilmadim. Avgustda bizda doim ish ko'p bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Hi Tom. It's Gary. How are you?
patterns.explanationUz:
Telefonda o'zini tanishtirish: 'IT IS + ism'
('I am' EMAS).

patterns.formula: It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all alone.
patterns.exampleEn: It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all alone. Suddenly, I heard a noise outside.
patterns.exampleUz: Sovuq, shamolli tun edi va men uyda yolg'iz edim. To'satdan tashqarida shovqin eshitdim.
patterns.explanationUz:
HIKOYA BOShLASh qolipi: QAChON + QAYERDA + KIM,
keyin 'Suddenly' bilan birinchi voqea.
